notes.title: Monthly revista #2
notes.notes:
[h3]Hola, ninjas! 🥷[/h3][p]August was a whirlwind in Nuevo Tokyo, and we're here to give you the lowdown on all the chaos, combos, and carnage that went down.

[b]Gamescom 2025 – Nuevo Tokyo takes over Cologne![/b]💥 We brought Mexican Ninja to [b]Gamescom[/b], and wow… the Narkuzas were shaking in their boots.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/4034db8e53ad6232b20330d27491913e9e465657.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/ae6d730b986f165295370f8cb8065546e7ffbc4d.jpg"][/img]Whether it was at the [b]Unity Invite-Only Showcase[/b] or the [b]Gamescom B2B Booth[/b] in the Romanian Pavilion, players got hands-on with the demo, slicing, dashing, and occasionally face-planting into chaos.[/p][p]Slots were limited, but the rebels who made it got exclusive early looks and even some [b]limited merch[/b] to prove they survived. 🛡️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/c62f325b4ff1e34a36f7813721a6f91027cf8757.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/0143626fcd8219ab122f46a5b4b1fbfbdfcc63c3.png"][/img][/p][p](Enjoy the condoms Joseph, and thanks for stopping by ;))[/p][p]We gave away T-shirts, stickers, periodico, condoms, and more! Deus mio!  [/p][p]Don't forget to check out our awesome IG stories we made while at the event below - some may even give you a chuckle.
[url="https://www.instagram.com/stories/highlights/18362453479156779"]https://www.instagram.com/stories/highlights/18362453479156779[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]MIX Fall Showcase[/b]⚡[/p][p]The chaos didn’t stop there - we got [b]officially accepted into the MIX Fall Showcase[/b]! August 29th came and went where we showed of a brand spanking new gameplay trailer!! 👀[/p][previewyoutube="dcCKwX_c1ew;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Why is this trailer not on our socials yet? Funny you ask, pendejo. We're actually [i]making it even better [/i]by adding more varied scenes, a swanky intro and more - in the meantime, check out the version we aired at the MIX above![/p][p][/p][p][b]Community Testing Starts Soon! [/b]🧪[/p][p]Thanks to all the ninjas who signed up for [b]testing in July and August[/b]! Your feedback will be a godsend. If you've played our build at gamescom, we're happy to report that bugs were squashed, combos perfected, and chaos refined. [/p][p][b]Sign ups close on Sep 3rd, so sign up now and join the rebellion![/b][/p][p][url="https://forms.office.com/e/EFS3cStLCQ"]https://forms.office.com/e/EFS3cStLCQ[/url]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/f5e72453e47c23e524db32245e28f9ec1dc4183f.png"][/img][/p][p]If you signed up already, check your inbox in the coming weeks a secret ninja message may be landing there soon. 😏

[b]Gameplay!![/b] 🎮
We also showed off plenty of new clips (with more coming in September!), here's a couple of our favourites!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/4d7e12e84c1f3648a679ac0bb13a4affb1e3118e.gif"][/img]Getting taken out has never been so stinky.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/f7e9f7d05369033f7655da884aacd43daec114cc.gif"][/img]Remember, a true ninja always looks up, because somehow there's falling explosive barrels and you don't wanna get hit by that do you?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/0a722b99da9d92ad0a251c663f7d98c044fbb222.gif"][/img][/p][p]We also showed a few animations we made both for El Ninja and the basic enemy types - mira![/p][p][/p][p]Finally, alongside Unity, we put together a short video highlighting how we used Cinemachine to create chaotic, dynamic and endlessly fun camera angles so you can slice Narkuzas in style! [/p][p]Check it out here!
[url="https://x.com/i/status/1958559064813654511"]https://x.com/i/status/1958559064813654511[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Le memes?![/b] 🐐[/p][p]We got so busy that we didn't cook up many incredible memes this time around - but we did make a banger one that everyone seems to love.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/8df5196bfb7431bd404299c0e337e9a7af5936cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We slacked on memes in August, so we’re passing the shuriken to you. Bring your best chaos to [url="https://discord.gg/ZfX7EEXeRb"]Discord[/url].


That’s a wrap for August! The streets of Nuevo Tokyo were messy, deadly, and hilarious - and September promises even more chaos, more wackiness, and more reasons for the Narkuzas to cry in the corner. 
[/p][p]And remember: [b]wishlist now or the Narkuza will bite you when you sleep.[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/c87dd582196fae604b9e511ff39982c0550e6ada.jpg"][/img]Stay sharp. Stay chaotic. [/p][p]
See you in the streets,
Fire[/p]

notes.title: Monthly Round Up - #1 - July 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hola ninjas!

Welcome to the first edition of our monthly round-up! A quick rundown of everything we've shown off/teased/announced/sliced/whatever. 

So let's start with what we all want to see - [b]GAMEPLAY[/b].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/43a8fc96c74402a6cb9e1a2a1a90b80641d2e26a.gif"][/img][/p][p]Using your skills wisely, combo-ing them together, and your own positioning are all crucial to get that combo counter higher and deal [b]MASSIVE[/b] amounts of damage to all enemies on screen - personal favorite? Whirlwind. Spin to win, always.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/9d7a5c1ef1af01a653a1d9d39d7e00e01b691420.gif"][/img][/p][p]While exploring the streets of Nuevo Tokyo, keep your ojos open for hidden paths leading to extra rewards![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/08cb6806bd827267e242e2e041efdd414360dea0.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]Speaking of ojos, yours aren't lying, we actually started with stick figures when prototyping the game, fun fact.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's talk bosses, they come in all shapes and sizes, some will dance...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/7652dfbf0d25e82f2aec133d308d398d8353abb5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Others aren't so [i]nice...[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/db2cc66ac5956f2bcbb12e82a9b612b65a9b2a7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
And in true [b]Mexican Ninja[/b] fashion, we shared a few memes to keep your bellys bouncing and your chuckles hearty - which one is your favorite?
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/cc3dce575e69049a48b5911c8903dfdc3b624c5a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/c66316be8cca5d39fb09cbd588861613a275dff6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/a5a87ff143464840de2422bc11de87a7eae7253b.png"][/img]
Don't be afraid to share your own memes on our [url="https://discord.gg/ZfX7EEXeRb"]discord[/url]! The more the merrier.

Of course, we had a cheeky narkuza that decided to glitch on us, but rest assured, he will pirouette no longer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/e8f0dca1760d8060d8613e7de0c4a0e2d170212d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]What's that? You want LORE? Ok, ok, calma. Here's a super awesome periodico detailing the world of Mexican Ninja - how opposing forces collided to create a war-torn oppressive Nuevo Tokyo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/2040a89cdcc57ca70f0acd85b8e847c4b6e78636.jpg"][/img]
Read the full periodico [url="https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1TtgDQNTds1RIoMv6JsePhNrsAWBJAw19"]here[/url]!

Lastly, if you're reading this and haven't wishlisted the game - what'chu waiting for pendejo? The button is right there![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/c87dd582196fae604b9e511ff39982c0550e6ada.jpg"][/img][/p][p]That's all for now - August will bring plenty of news, so stay tuned!
Cheers,
-Fire[/p]

notes.title: Mexican Ninja - Official Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hola ninjas!

After months of work we're beyond excited to finally reveal Mexican Ninja to the world, a solo mexican & japanese inspired beat 'em up roguelike.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/73667adf9d593a9a90572c2babece261a15bd685.gif"][/img][/p][p]We got espadas, we got hordes of bad guys to rip and tear (see what I did there?) through and the wildest, most insane lore that you [i]definitely, [/i]won't see coming. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/c2df3feb27be04ef98c3bee6f952c68bf4d55223.gif"][/img]

To celebrate the occasion, we fired up our very first trailer (yes with actual gameplay) all over our socials, which you should like, follow, or something.[/p][p]Anyways, here's the chingadeira, use your eye ability on it, enjoy the slaughter, those Narkuzas deserved it anyways.
[/p][previewyoutube="H3qTbCsOnUQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]If you're still scrolling through this news post, you're probably looking for links, here ya go:
[url="https://linktr.ee/MexicanNinjaTheGame"]https://linktr.ee/MexicanNinjaTheGame[/url]

That's it for now, spread the word, the ninja más cabron is about to make a name for himself.
-Fire[/p]
